regime_context: The detector is in a broad, narrowing rotation with no single dominant narrative (one_narrative=false, breadth_of_rotation frac 0.45). The cross-sectional momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), and the one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps=true). Momentum leader 'Memory, HBM & Storage' is ineligible (eligible=false), so the highest-ranked *eligible* trend themes are Energy Complex (rank 2), Energy EW, Big Pharma, and Health Care EW. Directional edge is weak across all themes; I give only modest, falsifiable leans and default conviction to low given the track record (dir_accuracy 0.444).
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Energy Complex challenger (score 1.415, eligible) closes the momentum gap with the ineligible leader Memory/HBM (score 2.305) AND Energy Complex's durability_bar rises above 0.75 with crowding retreating below z=0.5; that combination would mark a confirmed, investable eligible leadership, while a drop below trend-gate eligibility (eligible flips false) retires the watch.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is the highest-ranked eligible theme (rank 2, score 1.415) and is the headline/dominant eligible narrative. It is trend-gate eligible and shows strong breadth (0.955), but durability_bar is only 0.69 (mixed Hurst) and crowding_z is +1.03 (crowded). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme passes it, so a modest direction lean is supportable on the trend-gate leg alone. Rank is a focus lens, not a return forecast; crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
evidence: eligible=true (passes absolute-trend gate, the validated drawdown-control edge)
theses.dissent: Hurst_tag 'mixed' and durability_bar 0.69 are mediocre; the theme is already crowded, and headline/attention spikes often mark tops. The rank itself has near-zero forward IC, so the whole case rests on the trend gate's risk control, not on any return edge.

falsifier.text: XLE moves below its own 50-day average while the S&P 500 holds above its 50-day average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is eligible (trend-gate pass), rank 4, with the highest durability_bar among eligible themes (0.79) and a clear 'trend' Hurst tag. It is crowded (z 1.68), which only caps conviction — it does not argue for a fade. This is the most durable eligible trend in a rotation where eligible breadth is narrowing, supporting a defensive-trend lean via the validated trend gate.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.68 is the highest positive crowding read in the scorer set; attention has already piled in. Health care is a defensive flow and could lag if the 'broadening' rotation re-accelerates toward cyclicals.

falsifier.text: PPH underperforms XLV by 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: Non-AI Tech & Hardware is trend-gate eligible but shows the weakest breadth of any eligible trend theme at 0.385 (rank 11, durability 0.61). It passes the absolute-trend gate, but participation is tepid — the trend is carried by a very small number of names. With rotation breadth narrowing (0.45) and this theme's internal breadth poor, there is no edge to lean into; an avoid lean reflects absence of supportive legs rather than a bear call.
theses.dissent: Low breadth can precede a breadth catch-up; the trend gate passed, so the absolute trend is still intact, and an avoid call could miss a re-acceleration if the top-heavy names broaden out.

falsifier.text: XLK breadth (share of positive 50-day constituents) rises above 0.6 before the check-by date
